cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coffee Sunday? That year apart finally taught you the independence I kept trying to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beginner's practice. Eventually the pupil has to stop turning up just because I said so.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to keep a plan I didn't make. Coffee Monday, then. I can wait a day for my star pupil.
